summary: Tested new v2.2.0 Credential Management + Connection Health feature. 17/17 new backend tests pass, 22/22 prior regression tests pass (1 version assertion fixed). Frontend 11/11 flows verified: login, settings load, verify-all, ValidityPill countdown (decrements every second), credential expansion with masked values, edit/cancel, invalid-token rejection with visible sonner error toast 'Apify validation failed (HTTP 401)', MongoDB read-only view, regression on Dashboard/History/Audit Log. Two visual regressions found on Settings page that don't break the new feature but degrade UX.

ui_bugs.issue: After Verify All, Cloudinary card shows 'Cloud Name: N/A' and 'API Key: N/A'. The /api/settings/check-cloudinary endpoint correctly returns cloud_name='dlldchbe2' and api_key_hint='***1553' (verified via curl + pytest), but the UI no longer renders these fields. Regression vs iteration_9 which showed these values. Likely the SettingsPage state extraction was changed during refactor (perhaps reading from wrong key in the response or from a stale getRuntimeValue path).

After a successful Verify All, the Apify card simultaneously shows: top-level 'Connected' badge + 'Valid for 58m XXs' green pill AND inner rows reading 'Hashtag Token: Invalid (red)', 'Username Token: Invalid (red)', plus 'Profile Scraper / Reel Scraper / Hashtag Scraper: Inactive (red dots)'. This is contradictory — Apify status API returns connected=true with valid tokens. Likely caused by token_valid / actor_status fields being read from a renamed response field after the refactor, OR these per-token sub-statuses are no longer being populated by /api/apify/status. Confuses operators about whether the connection actually works.

action_items: Frontend (Settings): Fix Cloudinary card to display cloud_name and api_key_hint from /api/settings/check-cloudinary response (currently shows 'N/A')

Frontend (Settings): Fix Apify card so per-token rows and per-actor status reflect the actual /api/apify/status payload (currently all show Invalid/Inactive while top-level says Connected) — likely a response-field-rename issue introduced when APIFY_TOKEN constant was replaced with get_runtime_value()
critical_code_review_comments: config.get_runtime_value() pattern is cleanly used everywhere (apify_service, reels, settings) — no leftover APIFY_TOKEN constant references found
Encryption: Fernet key derived via PBKDF2 from JWT_SECRET — acceptable for v2.2; consider a dedicated CREDENTIALS_ENCRYPTION_KEY env var for production rotation
credentials_service.mask_value() correctly handles short values and non-sensitive (cloud_name) keys
_test_credential() correctly restores prior cloudinary.config on validation failure (good)
SettingsPage.jsx is 736 lines — close to the 700-line guideline; consider splitting ValidityPill / CredentialRow / ConnectionCard into separate files
Missing: a UI confirmation modal before overwriting a sensitive credential might be valuable (currently a single click saves)

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (all flows pass); 2 visual regressions in info display

seed_data_creation: None — used live .env tokens. After valid-update test, DELETE /api/settings/credentials/APIFY_TOKEN was called to restore .env fallback. No persistent overrides remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New credential management feature (v2.2.0) works end-to-end: encrypted DB overrides, live API validation before persistence, validity TTL countdown (60min apify/cloudinary, 30min mongodb), audit logging, masked display. Two minor UI regressions in info display on Apify + Cloudinary cards need fixing — the connections themselves work, only the inner field rendering is broken. After main agent fixes those, retest by navigating to /settings → click Verify All → confirm Cloudinary 'Cloud Name' shows 'dlldchbe2' (not N/A) and Apify per-token rows show 'Valid' (not Invalid).
